_comment: Per-market MM ladder. Set the starting ODDS (mid, in cents) for each outcome — the bot posts a capital-light BID ladder just inside them on BOTH sides, so users can buy (via mint) and sell (via complementary) right around your odds. Nothing leaves the MM wallet until a fill. `budgetUsd` caps the MAX total USDC the ladder can spend per market (your exposure); once that's filled, the MM is out and users trade each other. topSpreadCents is how far inside the mid the best bid sits (tight = users trade near the odds). Identify a market by gameId/slug/marketId. Override any default per-market via `params`.
